notes.title: 5th Anniversary Announcements
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Today marks the 5th anniversary of Booth: A Dystopian Adventure!

I may not be able to celebrate this milestone every year as I move forward with new projects, but the 5th anniversary feels like the perfect moment to share some announcements.

1. Merch in the Making

The first merchandise I’d like to create is a set of acrylic goods featuring adorable pixel art of the Booth characters—like the ones in this picture!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31467339/5d934a7d52823a43b5fc81be1765778a624b9d3e.png

Usually, only hit games get merch because there’s no point making it if no one wants to buy it. Booth isn’t exactly a blockbuster, but I still want to make these items—simply because I myself want to own them!

I’m still figuring out how to distribute them globally, but for now, my plan is to produce a limited batch and offer them at offline events.

2. A Dystopian Food Trilogy

This isn’t a sequel—but rather something new I think fans of Booth will enjoy: I’m working on a Dystopian Food Trilogy!

Why a trilogy instead of a direct sequel? Two main reasons:


 I feel Booth already told its story and explored its mechanics to the fullest, so a sequel wouldn't feel meaningful.
 I still find the combination of dystopia and food deeply compelling—and surprisingly underexplored.


So I’ve decided to build a full trilogy around that theme. Hopefully, it’ll help draw in new players and solidify my creative identity.

Here’s the current status:


 Booth is the first entry and already done.
 The second game’s prototype is finished.
 The third game is still in the concept phase.


My goal is to finish a demo of the second game later this year and officially announce it at a video game event. That said, getting into these events is extremely competitive—especially for a solo indie developer—so even if the game is ready, the reveal may take a bit longer.

In the meantime, I’ll keep working hard and aim to finish the full game by the end of 2026.

3. Follow Me for More Updates

While you're here, please consider following my Steam Developer Page so that you’ll be notified whenever I release a new game.

You can follow me on Bluesky as well if you’re also on it! I share game development updates there in English.

For even more info, check out my Homepage.

That’s all for now!

Being a full-time indie dev isn’t easy, but I’m still enjoying the ride—and I’ll keep making games as long as I can.

Thank you for supporting Booth all these years. See you next time, and happy 5th anniversary! 😊


Love from Iden,
GP

notes.title: If You Can't Run "Booth" on MacOS, Try This.
notes.content:
Hi,

Lately I've been receiving an increased amount of questions regarding not being able to run "Booth" on a Mac.

I studied the problem and found that it was due to newer MacOS having a stricter security policy with downloaded software and "Booth" being a game made with a pretty old version of GameMaker.

To solve the "Booth Is Damaged and Can’t Be Opened. You Should Move It To The Trash." problem, follow these steps:

1. Open "Booth.app" once either through Steam or directly from local files (and the above warning message will show).

2. Open your Mac's "System Settings" and find the "Privacy & Security" tab. Inside it you can find a section appeared talking about "Booth" (like the image below).

3. Click "Open Anyway" and "Booth" should run successfully from now on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31467339/3ce8691aeb791347f4f72a8f52b6d939b65f53cb.png


Hope this helps!


Love from Iden,
GP

notes.title: Thank You for 4 Years and 12k Copies!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

I can't believe it's been 4 years and here's the long overdue Elodie's illustration! Until now, Booth has sold over 12k copies worldwide and has reached 300 reviews. Thank you so much!

While they are not huge numbers, few indie titles on the niche side can achieve that. I'm more than grateful Booth can be one of them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31467339/a75ee1bdd56a6bdf5e4962299929683d36c5cadd.png

It has become such an emotional moment as I redrew Elodie after 4 years, and the sense of time flying by was only strengthened by how much my drawing skill has improved. :)

For a long time, I didn't realize how much I love the characters in Booth, but now I do. I would really like a chance to revisit them again in the future.

Lastly, a little bonus throwback: when Booth was first released, it was still called "Booth" not "Booth: A Dystopian Adventure." I changed the name for searchability but honestly, I like the simplicity of "Booth." And yeah, we were actually New and Trending for a while.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31467339/29899a1dd2392550f86afde41c3ac420a7fe5b21.png

Development Update

A couple of months ago, I started working on the controller support for Booth, but since Booth was designed to be played with mouse and keyboard, adding a comfortable controller support basically means rewriting most of the logic. Considering how much work it is and my immediate need to survive as a full-time indie game developer, I had to suspend that task and shift my focus to making a new game.

Apologies if anyone was waiting for that update to play. I can't promise when it will come out but I highly recommend playing Booth with mouse and keyboard if possible.

You can wishlist my new game now! It will be out next year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2775160/

Thank you and Happy 4th Anniversary!


Love from Iden,
Guanpeng

notes.title: Celebrating 1st Anniversary!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

One year ago Booth was released and it was a such a good ride from there, thanks to you! :)

Now I have a few things to share.


1. Booth's Original Soundtrack is now partly available on Youtube.

For best experience, please listen to them after you've beaten the game.
Five of the most requested tracks are picked, enjoy!

(You can buy the full album on Steam.)

One of them:

[previewyoutube=FSB9WLiC5xE;full][/previewyoutube]

2. Recommending some great content creators.

Some told me that it's extra fun to watch someone else play Booth, even if you already knew the story. So I tried, and it was! ; )

[previewyoutube=mQR8cLm_TeY;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=dd3nKQAQQh8;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=-FAqMz6cFs4;full][/previewyoutube]

3. Brand new save system.

In the latest update the save system was renewed and you can now restart from a previous day without needing to beat the game first. Also, now you will have 3 save slots to use. One for each restaurant, maybe?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31467339/8dc283b79c6f33aa9b128fb93ce37210ace3f3a1.png

4. About follow-up content of Booth.

I know many of you are expecting DLCs, but for me Booth is already complete in its current form. 

However, if I do want to expand on it, I might just go make an entirely different game based on Booth's worldview, like (spoiler alert) [spoiler]an escape room game happening during the time Katja was arrested[/spoiler].

Since I'm still a part-time developer, I can't make any promises here, sadly. But just bare in mind that if it ever happens, it's going to be a whole new game.

5. Next game from me?

My next game, which I've been making for the past year with 3 friends, will be revealed later this year.

I'm also working on a solo project but there's not much to share right now.

You can follow me on twitter for latest news: https://twitter.com/cguanpeng

That's all from me. As always, thank you all for reading, and supporting.
Happy 1st Anniversary!


Love from Iden,
Guanpeng

notes.title: FAQ & Content Updates
notes.content:
Frequently Asked Questions

Q1. The game window is bugged and I can't move my mouse to the right place.
Try restarting the game. If it doesn't work, you can join our Official Discord to report, and we'll help fix it.

Q2. The game crashed with a Win32 warning.
Try updating your graphics card's driver to the latest version.

Q3. I'm using a widescreen (such as 2560 x 1080) and can't click the options in the title room.
Press [ ESC ] to call out the setting menu and turn off the fullscreen.

Q4. It keeps saying that the apples and pears are wrong, why?
You forgot to sterilize them.

Q5. The start work button is gone. Where is it?
Did you just receive a new piece of equipment? You will have to bring it with you to the room with the conveyor belt. If it's another situation, please join our Official Discord to report, and we'll help solve it.

Q6. I just can't get S rank on a specific day. Is it a bug?
There're already players who got S rank on all days, so probably not. But do try restarting the game to get all parameters refreshed if it does seem bugged. (We're currently looking into this issue.)

Q7. Some tasks are too difficult. What can I do?
Try making good use of the rules, instead of just following them.

Q8. What do the coffins mean?
Hint: pay attention to what your supervisor said. Also referring to John Dickson Carr's The Three Coffins since we are trying to escape the locked-room.

Q9. I want to discuss about the game!
Feel free to join our Official Discord! It's a lot of fun talking to other players (and the dev). Trust me.

Q10. Will there be a Colorblind Mode?
Yes, we will definitely work on that and let you know in future updates. Stay tuned!

Q11. Is there a way to help [spoiler]Katja[/spoiler]?
[spoiler]The fate of Katja will be hinted after the Tuland ending if you asked DEES to help her.[/spoiler]

Q12. What does [spoiler]the postcard[/spoiler] mean?
[spoiler]As it says, check all the letters you received for information, which you can do in the game loading room.[/spoiler]

Q13. I want to see more about the story/characters of Booth. Will there be any DLCs?
It depends a lot on how well Booth sells. But, I love the characters and want to write more about them, and I do feel there's room for a free DLC or two. So again, stay tuned if you're insterested.

Content Updates

For Old Players:
Since the update on July 30th (v.1.1.8), there're two 'new' contents put back in the game. (They were mistakenly taken out in previous versions, sorry.)

They are: 
1) the booth tour on Day 1, right after you got off the airship.
2) the [spoiler]scene[/spoiler] after you [spoiler]dialed the postcard phone number[/spoiler].

For All Players:
Below are some future updates we are currently thinking about:

1) Colorblind Mode.
2) There will be at least one mini-game on Gameboi that you can play.
3) The ability to rewrite your progress without losing the access to future days in new game plus.
4) Assist Mode for players who do not want to do tasks at all. (Done in v.1.2.1.)
5) Endless Mode for players who love doing tasks. (Also Leaderboards maybe?)


Lastly, thank you all for the reviews and support! :)


Love from Iden,
Guanpeng
